dataset.name: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (NCI CCR, 2018)
dataset.description: Independent diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cohort with open GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq STAR-counts and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: NCI Center for Cancer Research DLBCL tumor biopsies from the Schmitz et al. genomic classification study; NCICCR-DLBCL is retained separately from TCGA-DLBC.
dataset.publication_citation: Schmitz et al. New England Journal of Medicine 2018

metadata.source_program: National Cancer Institute Center for Cancer Research
metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TCGA-TRACE, but matrix downloads remain disabled pending a dedicated redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: One tumor STAR-counts file is selected per endpoint-complete participant by sample submitter ID, aliquot submitter ID and file UUID. GDC TPM is transformed once as log2(TPM + 1).

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TCGA-TRACE applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
